item.title: Version 1.4.2
item.description:
v1.4.2

  • Restored taskbar highlight and tray blink when apps get Dock badges or notifications.
  • Fixed the taskbar hiding itself while Auto-hide was off (accessory overlays such as Cua Driver were treated as fullscreen).
⚠️ 辅助功能权限 / Accessibility Permission

本次起使用稳定代码签名。若升级后「合并多窗口 / 标题显示」无效：系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 辅助功能，选中 RetroWin 点 − 移除后重启应用并重新允许。之后同一签名升级通常无需再授权。

Builds now use a stable code signature. If merge-windows / title display stop working after this update: System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility → select RetroWin → −, relaunch, and Allow again. Later updates with the same signature should keep the grant.
